spans.s: = वृथा, RV. viii, 43, 4; 5 (Sāy. = पृथक्).
(prob. connected with √ 2. वृ) at will, at pleasure, at random, easily, lightly, wantonly, frivolously, RV.; Br.; Gobh.; Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh.
in vain, vainly, uselessly, fruitlessly, idly, TBr. &c. &c. (with √ कृ, ‘to make useless’, disappoint, frustrate; with √ भू, ‘to be useless’, be disappointed or frustrated)
wrongly, falsely, incorrectly, unduly, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
&c. See p. 1007, col. 3.
वृथा—कथा f. idle talk, nonsense, W.
वृथा—कर्मन् n. an action done uselessly or for pleasure, non-religious act, Āpast.
वृथा˚कार (˚थाक्˚), m. a false form, empty show, Pañcat. i, 62 (others ‘one whose form is vain or illusory’).
वृथा—कुल-समाचार mfn. one whose family and practices (or ‘family-practice’) are idle or low, MBh.
वृथा—कृसर-संयाव m. a kind of food, (consisting of wheat-flour, rice and sesamum and prepared for no religious purpose), Mn. v, 7.
वृथा˚ग्नि (˚थाग्नि), m. common fire, any fire, AV.; Prāyaśc.
वृथा˚घात (˚थाघ्˚), m. striking uselessly, killing unnecessarily, W.
वृथा˚चार (˚थाच्˚), m. frivolous or lawless in conduct, MBh.
वृथा—छेद m. useless or frivolous cutting, Yājñ.
वृथा—जन्मन् n. useless or unprofitable birth, MW.
वृथा—जात mfn. born in vain (i.e. ‘one who neglects the prescribed rites’), Mn. v, 89.
वृथा˚ट्या (˚थाट्या), f. strolling about in an idle manner, travelling for pleasure (regarded as a vice in a king), Mn. vii, 47.
वृथा˚त्मायास (˚थात्म्˚), m. useless self-mortification, Nāg.
वृथा—त्व n. fruitlessness, futility, Sāh.
वृथा—दान n. a useless or improper gift (as a gift promised to courtesans, wrestlers &c.; accord. to some there are 16 kinds of these gifts), Mn. viii, 139.
वृथा˚न्न (˚थान्न), n. food for one's own use only, Kauś.; Gaut.
वृथा—पक्व mfn. cooked at random (i.e. only for one's own use), Gobh.
वृथा—पलित mfn. grown gray in vain, Śiś. (cf. -वृद्ध).
वृथा—पशु-घ्न mfn. one who kills cattle wrongly or unnecessarily (i.e. not for sacrifice), Mn. v, 38.
वृथा—प्रजा f. a woman who has borne children in vain, MārkP.
वृथा—प्रतिज्ञ mfn. one who makes a promise rashly, MW.
वृथा—भोग mfn. enjoying in vain or to no purpose, ib.
वृथा—मति mfn. foolish-minded, wrong-minded, MBh.

वृथा—मांस n. ‘flesh taken at random’ or ‘useless flesh’ (i.e. flesh not destined for the gods or Pitṛs but for one's own use only; the eater of such flesh is said to be born as a demon), ŚBr.; Mn.; Gaut. &c.
वृथा—मांस m. one who eats ‘useless’ flesh, MW.
वृथा˚र्तवा (˚थार्त्˚), f. ‘one whose menstrual discharge is fruitless’, a barren woman, Gal.
वृथा˚लम्भ (˚थाल्˚), m. cutting or plucking unnecessarily, Mn. xi, 144.
वृथा—लिङ्ग mf(आ)n. having no true cause, unsubstantiated, MBh.
वृथा—लिङ्गिन् mfn. one who wears a sectarian mark without any right to it, Viṣṇ.
वृथा—वाच् f. frivolous or untrue speech, AitĀr.; Gobh.
वृथा—वादिन् mfn. speaking falsely or untruly, Pañcad.
वृथा—वृद्ध mfn. grown old in vain (i.e. without growing wise), Bālar. (cf. -पलित).
वृथा—व्रत n. a false religious observance, MBh.
वृथा—व्रत mfn. one who performs false r˚ ob˚, Hariv.
वृथा—श्रम m. vain exertion, useless labour, Pañcat.
वृथा—ष॑ह् (strong षा॑ह्), mfn. one who easily overcomes or conquers, RV.
वृथा—संकर-जात mfn. born in vain through the mixture of different castes (and hence neglectful in the performance of duties), MW.
वृथा—सुत mfn. pressed out in vain, Nir. xi, 4.
spoken in vain, MārkP.
born or produced in vain, Mn. ix, 147.
pl. water flowing at random (not in a channel), ŚBr.
exerting one's self in vain, BhP.
